description: Update the recap, date, number and meta fields of SessionSummary mnemons. To change the story, use update_mnemons_content.

date.description: When the session was played: ISO date (2024-02-10) or date-time. Set it for a past chapter brought into Argo. Leave it out for a summary linked to a calendar session: it then takes the session's date. Linking never clears it. An empty string clears it.

entryId.description: Mnemon entry id (hex) or exact title.

recap.description: Short recap, 1-3 sentences, ending on where the party stands. Shown as "Previously on" on the next session and the campaign Dashboard. The full story goes in the Markdown body.

sessionNumber.description: The session's number in the party's history, a positive whole number, kept as written. Leave it out to let Argo number the summary by its place in the history (after the highest number before it). Linking never clears it. 0 clears it.

name: update_session_summary_mnemons
title: Update session summary mnemons
